display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (NREM): (Apneas with >= 3% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 3% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of NREM sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in NREM sleep (>= 3% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hnrbp3 + hnrop3 + canbp3 + canop3 + oanbp3 + oanop3 + manrbp3 + manrop3)/(slpprdp - minremp)
